assessment: In this manuscript, the authors discovered a new function of Rai14, an F-actin binding protein, in dendritic spine dynamics. They showed that Rai14 is localized at the spine neck and regulates spine density and function. Heterozygous Rai14 knockout mice showed impaired learning and memory and depressive-like behavior. Overall, this study provides novel insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying spine dynamics and depressive-like behavior.
